pick.name: shadcn/ui
pick.what: Copy-in React + Tailwind components on Radix or Base UI, with an official MCP server and registries
pick.why: The default that Claude Code, v0 and Claude Design all generate; you own the code; MCP lets Claude install components.
pick.install: npx shadcn@latest init ; claude: npx shadcn@latest mcp init --client claude

alts.name: Mantine
alts.why: Pick when you want 100+ ready components (dates, forms, charts) without assembling them.

alts.name: MUI (Material UI)
alts.why: Enterprise-familiar look; advanced grid/date pickers are paid (MUI X Pro).
alts.free_limits: Core free; MUI X Pro/Premium paid

decision: shadcn/ui is what every AI generator and most docs assume, so Claude Code produces it with the fewest mistakes. Choose Mantine if you prefer a packaged library over owning component code.
details: Mobile/desktop UI kits follow the framework chosen by the app-stack track.

verify.note: Shallow check only: free/commercial terms are consistent with the cited licence; not re-opened in this pass.
